text:
emma: quick postmortem follow-up for helix (dedicated/private). summary: onprem failover triggered a vpc-peering flap that caused tenant isolation for ~18m. capturing owners + timelines here — want concrete action items and short owners so we can close the postmortem checklist.

sanjay: got it. i ran tcpdump on the peering link during the window, looks like BGP session flapped because multicast storm in their colo triggered CPU spike on the edge router. logged in jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4123

liv: adding context — customer uses a third-party SD-WAN box; vendor firmware buggy with heavy ARP bursts. they reproduced in staging when we simulated interface flaps.

maria: proposed actions: 1) pin routing fallback and more aggressive route dampening on our edge (owner: sanjay, due: 2026-04-02) 2) vendor firmware request + staging test (owner: helix-network, coord: liv, due: 2026-04-09) 3) runbook update for isolation detection + automated rollback to dedicated fallback model (owner: jon, due: 2026-04-05)

jon: can we also add a synthetic health check for VPC peering (TCP handshake + bgp? simple) that triggers before calling a customer failover? i can prototype. owner: jon, PR to infra repo.

sanjay: ack on runbook. i'll open INF-4123 subtask for route-dampening config and a tentative rollback play. assign me.

emma: note — we should capture recurrence pattern: this is second similar onprem isolation with sd-wan vendor in last 9 months (see INF-2871). recurring pattern -> treat as class P2 for onprem peering. suggests we add long-lived monitoring & scheduled vendor firmware audits.

liv: Agreed. action: create cadence doc with vendor audit items. owner: liv, due: 2026-04-12.

maria: also recommend adding detection rule to alert when peer RTT variance > 40ms AND bgp updates > 5/min. if both true -> page oncall and create auto-fallback to hosted model. owner: emma, engineering tie-in with telemetry team. due: 2026-04-07.

ops-bot: incident summary: isolation duration 18m, impacted tenants: helix-prod, helix-staging, severity: sev2. Linked: INF-4123.

jon: quick technical note for the PR: sample healthcheck script (will iterate)
```bash
# vpc-peering-healthcheck.sh
set -e
nc -z -w 3 10.12.0.1 179 || exit 2  # bgp port check
ping -c 3 10.12.0.1 | tail -1
```

liv: testing plan: simulate ARP burst + interface flap in our lab with vendor VM, run healthcheck, ensure auto-fallback triggers and app-level latencies stay within SLO. owner: liv + helix SEs.

emma: ok owners summary (copied from thread):
- route dampening & edge config: sanjay (due 2026-04-02)
- runbook update + auto-fallback: jon (due 2026-04-05)
- detection rule + telemetry hookup: emma (due 2026-04-07)
- vendor firmware request & staging test: liv (due 2026-04-09)
- vendor audit cadence doc: liv (due 2026-04-12)
- infra PR for healthcheck: jon (draft by 2026-03-29)

emma: i'll add these to the postmortem checklist and ping legal for an SLA carveout discussion with helix (we may need an explicit onprem peering SLO). tagging @sanjay @jon @liv for visibility. :eyes: :calendar:

sanjay: noted. will put a config change window on 04/02, prefer low-traffic hours.

maria: once done, can we schedule a 30-min verification call with helix SEs and engineering to walk through fixes? owner: maria, target week of 2026-04-13.

emma: perfect — i'll update INF-4123 with owners + dates and mark follow-ups. closing thread but will repost if any blocker arises. :white_check_mark:
